name: AgnView
subtitle: Watch your AI coding agents
promotionalText: Follow the console, send prompts, check pipelines and usage limits from your phone. Needs the free AgnView desktop app. Try the built-in demo first.
description:
AgnView for iOS is a companion for the free AgnView desktop app. You need AgnView on a Windows PC or a Mac. Get it at github.com/tlaskar-git/AgnView/releases/latest. The phone app does not run agents itself. It shows and controls the agents on your own computer.

Try it first. The app includes a demo mode with sample data, so you can see every screen before you pair a computer.

What you can do
- Watch live console output from your coding agents.
- Send prompts to Claude Code, Codex and AntiGravity. Pick the model and effort for each prompt.
- See the live sessions your computer holds open.
- Read your pipelines, create new ones, request a revision or mark a task failed.
- Check usage limits: the percentage used, the time to reset and the per-model rows.
- Attach files from your computer to a prompt or a pipeline.
- Use it on the same Wi-Fi or away from home over iroh, an encrypted peer-to-peer connection.

How pairing works
1. Install AgnView on your computer and start it.
2. Open the pairing screen and show the QR code.
3. Open AgnView on your phone and scan the code.
That is all. There is no account and no sign-in.

Privacy
- No account, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking.
- Your pairing key stays on your phone, in the Keychain.
- Prompts and console output travel only between your phone and your own computer.
- Away from your Wi-Fi, iroh can use public relay servers run by a third party. The traffic stays encrypted end to end.
- The app sends nothing to the developer.

The camera is used only to scan the pairing QR code. Local network access is used only to reach your own computer.

AgnView works with Claude Code, Codex and AntiGravity. These names are trademarks of their owners. AgnView is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

Support and source: github.com/tlaskar-git/AgnView-iOS-app
whatsNew:
First release for iPhone and iPad.

- Console with live output and a prompt composer
- Model and effort menus for each agent
- Sessions, pipelines and usage limits
- Same Wi-Fi or away from home over iroh
- Demo mode with sample data, so you can look around before you pair a computer
reviewNotes:
How to test with no hardware: open the app and tap Try the demo. Every screen works with built-in sample data: Console (send a prompt, open the Model and Effort menus, filter by agent), Sessions, Pipelines (New pipeline, Refresh, delete), Usage (Refresh) and Settings (Exit demo). A banner on every screen says "Demo mode. Sample data only. Nothing is connected." The demo makes no network connection and needs no login.

The app is a companion for the free AgnView desktop app for Windows and Mac, which runs the coding agents. A real pairing needs that desktop app: https://github.com/tlaskar-git/AgnView/releases/latest . The reviewer does not need it.

No sign-in or account is needed. There is no in-app purchase and no advertising.

Permissions: Camera, only to scan the pairing QR code that the desktop app shows (a pairing link can be pasted instead). Local Network, only to reach the user's own computer on the same Wi-Fi.

Remote access: away from the local network the app connects to the user's computer through iroh, an open source peer-to-peer protocol. It can use public relay servers run by n0. The traffic is end-to-end encrypted. No data goes to the developer.

The privacy policy is at https://github.com/tlaskar-git/AgnView-iOS-app/blob/main/PRIVACY.md .
